subject.title: Feature: Add costCurrency config option to customize cost display currency

question: Should OpenClaw add non-USD currency semantics for configured model costs, and if yes should currency live per model, per provider, globally, or only as a display preference?
rationale: The requested behavior touches a high-bar config surface plus stored/session cost names, `/usage` output, status output, Control UI aggregation, docs, and USD telemetry, so code review cannot safely choose the product/accounting contract.

options.title: Define the currency contract first
options.body: Choose the scope and accounting/display semantics before implementation so mixed-provider totals and existing USD fields stay honest.

options.title: Keep configured model costs USD-only
options.body: Leave the current contract intact and treat non-USD provider price tables as unsupported until maintainers want a larger accounting change.

options.title: Add display-only formatting
options.body: Allow a narrow symbol/ISO-code display preference while explicitly preserving USD-like stored totals and documenting the ambiguity.

recommendation.title: Define the currency contract first
recommendation.body: Choose the scope and accounting/display semantics before implementation so mixed-provider totals and existing USD fields stay honest.

likelyOwner.reason: The cost/session history and product-surface impact make `steipete` the strongest available routing candidate for the currency contract choice.
